title: rsna-knee-2nd-place-code
subtitle: Inference code, configs and offline DICOM decoder wheels, RSNA Knee 2nd place
description: The `knee` package, `configs/` (member recipes and the blend), `external/` (Matthew Liew's inference code for mil-reader and pf-specialist, unchanged), `predict.py` and `wheels/` (pylibjpeg, pylibjpeg-libjpeg, pylibjpeg-openjpeg, python-gdcm for Python 3.13; each wheel keeps its own licence), installed offline by `predict.py`.
